student_v1_contract.accepted_limitation: Practice model calls are request-bound. Completed work persists, but an in-flight recommendation, review, hint, title, or preference-merge request is not guaranteed to finish after the page closes.

final_gate.reason: The authenticated disposable Student browser suite passed all required journeys with exact cleanup, temporary-server shutdown, process-environment clearing, and zero fixture residue. This classification applies only to Student V1, not whole-site deployment readiness.
final_gate.provider_behavior: Practice uses the configured enabled/default compatible Provider, which may be DeepSeek or Gemini OpenAI-compatible depending on the environment. Deterministic grade uses no Provider.
final_gate.database_state: Migrations 0043 through 0048 are unchanged: 0043 remains PARTIALLY_APPLIED_FAILED, 0044 was applied manually exactly once, and 0045/0046/0047/0048 retain clean-database live validation.
final_gate.cleanup_result: PASS: exact-ID cleanup, zero fixture residue, temporary servers stopped, and process-only environment values cleared.
final_gate.non_blocking_diagnostic: One failed PRACTICE_PREFERENCES request occurred during the otherwise passing private self-study journey; track as P2 diagnostic debt.
final_gate.next_classification_work: Keep Student V1 closed. Address remaining P2 product, UX, resilience, and preference-request diagnostics in separately scoped work while preserving the request-bound Practice limitation.
